A chronology of frequently discussed UFO and SETI related events
                         (from 1877-2006) 1 2

   [Preliminary draft of “Koi Chrono Core”3 by Isaac Koi as at 2006.0208]


Date        Event
YYYY.MMDD
1877.0000 Pre-1877 incidents and issues are not covered in this chronology. 4*****
1877.0900 SETI: Following observations during a particularly favourable opposition of
          Mars, Giovanni Virginio Schiaparelli drew maps of Mars with lines which he
          referred to as “canali”. A debate ensued over the possible existence of canals
          on Mars. 5*****
1878.0124 John Martin reports a dark “object” high up in the northern sky. The “object”
          was reported as being about “the size of a large saucer” and “evidently at a
          great height”. 6*****
1883.0812 Photograph taken by astronomer Jose A y Bonilla at the Zacatecas
          Observatory in Mexico of objects crossing the face of the Sun. Some authors
          have referred to these photographs as “the first UFO photographs”. 7*****
1889.1225 One of several dates (depending upon the source) ascribed to the alleged
          disappearance of one Oliver Lerch (or, again depending upon the source,
          Oliver Larch or Oliver Thomas) whilst leaving footprints in snow when
          carrying a bucket to a well in Wales (or South Bend, Indiana). 8*****
1896.0000 Astronautics: Konstantin Eduardovich Tsiolkovskii9***** writes “Exploration
          of Space by Means of Reactive Apparatus”. 10*****
1896.1100 Airship Wave between mid-November 1896 to the end of April 1897, with
          sporadic earlier sightings of airships.11*****
1897.0417 Alleged airship crash in Aurora, Texas involving reports of a badly disfigured
          pilot not an inhabitant of this world.12 13*****
1897.0419 Alleged airship encounter involving attempted calf-napping on the ranch of
          Alexander Hamilton at Le Roy, Kansas (sometimes referred to as LeRoy,
          Kansas). 14*****
1898.0000 Novel: Wells, H G15 16***** “The War of the Worlds”. 17*****
1900.0000 Book: Flourney, Th “From India to the Planet Mars”. Focuses on claims by
          Swiss medium “Helene Smith” (a pseudonym for Catherine Elise Muller) to
          have had psychic contact with a Martian intelligence. [Order from USA]
          18
            *****
1900.1217 SETI: The Pierre Guzman prize (commonly referred to as “the Guzman
          Prize”) of one hundred thousand francs is announced in Paris by Clara
          Gouguet in memory of her son by a former marriage. The prize was to be
          awarded “a celui qui aura trouve le moyen de communiquer avec an astre autre
          que la planet Mars (“to him who has found the means of communicating with
          a star other than Mars”). The prize was administered by the French Academy
          of Sciences. 19 20*****
1901.0209 An article by Nikola Tesla entitled “Talking with the Planets” is published in
          Collier’s Weekly in which he stated that “at the present stage of progress, there

Date        Event
YYYY.MMDD
            would be no insurmountable obstacle in constructing a machine capable of
            conveying a message to Mars, nor would there be any great difficulty in
            recording signals transmitted to us by the inhabitants of that planet, if they be
            skilled electricians”. He described “mysterious effects” he claimed to have
            observed and commented that “the feeling is constantly growing on me that I
            had been the first to hear the greeting of one planet to another”.21 22 23*****
1902.0102   SETI: Robert H Goddard24***** writes an essay entitled “The Habitability of
            Other Worlds” in which he deduced the existence of extrasolar planetary
            systems and commented “that among these countless planets there are
            conditions of heat and light equivalent to those we experience; and if this is the
            case, and the planet is near our age and size, there may very likely exist human
            beings like ourselves, probably with strange costumes and still stranger
            manners”. 25*****
1905.0000   Britain: “Welsh lights” reports (commonly referred to as “the Egryn lights”).
            Commonly linked to the Welsh Methodist revival of that year and the preacher
            Mrs Mary Jones. 26*****
1908.0630   An explosion occurs over the Tunguska region of Russia. (Commonly referred
            to as “the Tunguska Event”). 27*****
1909.0000   Worldwide waves of airship sightings during 1909-1910 and 1913, with
            sporadic later reports. 28*****
1915.0821   Britain: Alleged abduction/disappearance at Gallipoli of the 1/5 Norfolks
            battalion of the British 163rd Brigade. (Commonly referred to as “the Vanished
            Battallion incident” or “the Vanished Norfolks hoax”). Linked by a few
            authors to UFOs.29*****
1917.1013   Alleged apparition at Fatima.30*****
1918.0000   Astronautics: Robert H Goddard31 writes about the use of suspended
            animation32***** for interstellar travel in his unpublished manuscript entitled
            “The Ultimate Migration”. 33*****
1919.0000   Book: Fort, Charles 34***** “The Book of the Damned” 35 36*****
1919.0120   SETI: The New York Times prints an article entitled “Radio to Stars,
            Marconi’s Hope” in which Guglielmo Marconi is reported to have stated that
            “… communication with intelligences on other stars … may some day be
            possible” and that he had received unexplained signals which might have
            originated from the stars. 37*****
1923.0000   Book: Fort, Charles38 “New Lands”39 40*****
1924.0822   SETI: During an approach of Mars, David Todd attempts to detect radio
            signals from that planet. 41*****
1929.0000   Astronautics: “Generation ship” idea proposed by John D Bernal42***** in his
            book “The World, the Flesh, and the Devil”. 43*****
1931.0000   Book: Fort, Charles44 “Lo!” 45 46*****
1931.0126   Fortean Society founded. 47*****
1932.0000   Book: Fort, Charles48 “Wild Talents” 49 50*****
1933.0000   Sightings of “ghost airplanes” and “ghost fliers” reported over Scandinavia
            between 1933 and 1937, with sporadic reports in other countries. 51*****

1946.0000 “Ghost Rockets” (or “ghost bombs” or “spook bombs”) reported in Sweden
          and neighboring Scandinavian countries from 1946-1948, with sporadic earlier
          sightings. 76*****
1946.0500 Operation Overcast renamed Operation Paperclip77*****, continuing US
          attempts to obtain German technology and scientists. 78*****
1947.0317 US Navy contract for development of a place with a flat circular body is
          terminated. The plane had the military designation XF-5U-1 and was based on
          the lighter Chance Vought V-173 prototype (also known as the Zimmerman
          “Flying Pancake”, the “Flying Pancake” and the “Navy Flounder”) which had
          been flown for the first time on 1942.1123.79*****
1947.0621 Maury Island, Washington alleged sighting and debris, involving Harold A
          Dahl with a related alleged sighting the following day by Dahl’s superior –
          Fred Lee Crisman. Dahl and Crisman are often referred to as harbor
          patrolmen. The incident is commonly referred to as “the Maury Island hoax”
          or “the Maury Island incident”. 80 81 82 83 84*****
1947.0624 Businessman/pilot Kenneth Arnold of Boise, Idaho claims to see 9 objects
          flying “like a saucer would if you skipped it across the water” near Mount
          Rainer in the Cascade Mountains in Washington State. 85 86 87 88 89 90*****
1947.0624 Portland prospector Fred M Johnson reports several UFOs in the sky, in
          Cascade Mountains of Orgeon. Fred Johnson claimed the compass hand on his
          watch moved from side to side during the sighting. 91 92 93 94 95 96*****

1947.0814 Poll: Results of first Gallup Poll including questions on UFOs are released,
          indicating that 9 out of 10 Americans had heard of the phenomenon. One

          respondents selected “Other explanations” than those offered. 135 136*****
